title: Rune UI rework: owner-approved top queue category
queue_note: Owner 2026-11-14 authorized this category at the top of the feature queue with difficulty 3. Canonical executable queue is plans/queue-050.jsonl; dependencies, preparation, Terra review, resource limits and release gates remain mandatory.

tasks.title: Complete Rune Phase 0 feasibility gate
tasks.goal: Complete the already-approved Phase 0 spikes and publish a measured go/no-go report for connecting the Rune prototype to the existing Zene engine.
acceptance: Exercise the six prototype surfaces against a real engine and real project; prove engine state and rendered audio with render or engine meter/peak evidence.
Report command/ack and subscription latency under load, including p95 and whether optimistic edits reconcile; measure playhead and meters at display rate.
Build, open, and run deterministic headless checks on Linux, Windows MSVC, and macOS; separate hosted CI evidence from any local cross-target check.
Check native plug-in editor open/focus/close/stacking behavior on Wayland and X11 and obtain platform evidence for Windows and macOS, stating any CI-only limitation.
Exercise transport, track list, and mixer with Orca; document evidence and concrete follow-up needs for NVDA and VoiceOver.

Deliver explicit GO, NO-GO, or BLOCKED per spike and an overall recommendation; list control-surface gaps for headless-engine operation and audio editing; distinguish removing the Qt window from any later removal of Qt libraries without prescribing speculative bulk/streaming work.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.
tasks.terra_human_scenario: A musician opens Rune on a real project, starts and stops playback, seeks, changes tempo, mutes and adjusts a track, moves a clip, adds a note, and confirms the rendered result. Terra records visible state and engine/audio evidence; screenshots alone do not establish sound. Terra also conducts the specified plug-in-window and Orca checks in an isolated display/session.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Run existing prototype tests and add repeatable integration checks for command state, reconnect/error cases, and measured latency collection. Preserve exact commands, logs, platform/build identity, and report values; zero-test runs are failures.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Must use the real control socket and real project on the real engine. Audio proof must be an offline render comparison, non-silent render/engine peaks, or documented safe real-device session; Dummy playback is not audible proof.
tasks.notes: This is approved side-project Phase 0 work. Do not modify product, pipeline, or other agents' worktrees. No product integration proceeds without an overall GO and documented limitations.

tasks.title: Rune engine process lifecycle and connection
tasks.goal: Start, connect to, supervise, and close the existing engine without a Qt main window from the Rune product UI with clear handling for unavailable or failed connections.
acceptance: On supported platforms, Rune opens the engine through the documented control connection and shows a usable project state without creating a Qt window.
Connection refusal, engine startup failure, engine exit, UI exit, and reconnect produce actionable status and do not corrupt or silently discard project data.
The engine remains independently startable and usable by existing control clients; no new mandatory Qt dependency is introduced into the UI process.
Lifecycle and protocol compatibility are covered by deterministic tests and platform CI.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.
tasks.terra_human_scenario: Launch Rune into a project, close and reopen the UI, then simulate an unavailable engine and a dropped connection. Terra verifies clear status, successful reconnect, and preserved project state.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Test normal launch/close, connection refusal, unexpected engine exit, reconnect, stale socket cleanup, and project preservation with isolated runtime directories; exercise supported OS process and IPC paths in CI.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Run against the actual engine binary and control socket on Linux, Windows, and macOS CI paths. Capture engine process state and protocol logs, not a mock-only pass.

tasks.title: Synchronize Rune with live engine project state
tasks.goal: Present current project and transport state in Rune and keep it correct as the engine changes, reconnects, or reports failures.
acceptance: Track, clip, note, mixer, selection, and transport state shown by Rune corresponds to a live engine project rather than demo fixtures.
Engine-originated changes and command replies converge to one correct visible state without stale edits overwriting newer state.
Any added subscription, high-rate, or bulk data contract is additive, justified by measured Phase 0 evidence, bounded, and covered for reconnect, ordering, and version compatibility.
State flow remains responsive on representative projects without unbounded queues or repeated whole-project transfers per frame.

tasks.title: Rune transport, loop, and real playback
tasks.goal: Make transport controls operate on the existing engine and communicate truthful playback position, tempo, loop, and audio state.
acceptance: Play, stop, seek, tempo, and loop actions use engine state and display acknowledged/current values, including errors and boundary behavior.
Playback produces the expected real engine output and playhead/meter feedback remains responsive under the Phase 0 load profile.
Audio evidence distinguishes offline/Dummy render proof from an audible real-device session and never labels silent/dummy playback as sound.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.
tasks.terra_human_scenario: Open a non-empty project, play, seek during playback, change tempo, set a loop and stop. Terra verifies controls, position and loop state; verifies audio with a safe real device or an independently inspected engine render/peaks.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Cover play/stop transitions, seek bounds, tempo validation, loop boundaries, lost acknowledgments, undo expectations where applicable, and render output against a known project.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Run against the product engine with both offline render/peak evidence and, when safely available, a real device session. Record latency and the actual backend.

tasks.title: Rune browser and arrangement first composition flow
tasks.goal: Let a musician find available content, add it to a real track, and create and edit a basic arrangement in Rune.
acceptance: Search and browse installed instrument/audio content, add content to the project, and make missing, unsupported, or failed loads visible.
Select, move, resize, duplicate, split, mute, and delete supported audio/MIDI clips with consistent grid behavior and immediate state feedback.
Edits reach the engine, remain undoable/redoable, and preserve the intended project state after resynchronization.
A newly created arrangement can be rendered or played through the engine; the browser's sample art or demo metadata is never substituted for real content/audio evidence.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.

tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Test search/filter, insertion, unsupported content, clip edits and boundaries, snapping, selection, undo/redo, resync, and non-silent expected render through a fixture project.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Use installed real content and engine clip state; retain the resulting project/render or meter peaks and the exact sample/instrument identity.

tasks.title: Rune piano-roll note editing
tasks.area: Rune piano roll and MIDI command mapping
tasks.goal: Edit notes and velocities in a real MIDI clip with engine-backed state and history.
acceptance: Open a MIDI clip and add, select, move, resize, delete notes and change velocity with visible pitch/time/value feedback.
Edits follow the interaction contract, use engine state, and undo/redo correctly through the engine history.
Edited notes survive project save/reopen and produce expected non-silent output when played through a compatible instrument.

tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Test note bounds, grid behavior, overlap/selection rules from the interaction contract, add/move/resize/delete, velocity, undo/redo, reopen, and expected MIDI render.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Use a real MIDI clip and instrument in the product engine; capture note state and rendered output/peaks.

tasks.title: Rune mixer and effect workflow
tasks.goal: Expose useful live mixer state and the basic track/effect controls needed to shape the first composition.
acceptance: Show engine-backed track/master meters and allow volume, pan, mute, and solo changes with clear current state.
Add, configure where supported, bypass, and remove an effect through existing engine behavior; errors and unavailable controls are clear.
Mix and effect actions preserve routing, undo/history expectations, and audio output; meters are not fabricated demo values.

tasks.terra_human_scenario: Balance two sounding tracks, mute/solo, insert and bypass an effect, and compare audible/rendered output. Terra records actual engine channel state plus a render or safe audio session; screenshots do not prove meters are live.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Test fader/pan bounds, mute/solo state, effect insertion/bypass/removal, error cases, undo/history, channel state, and render behavior with known audio.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Use two non-silent engine sources, inspect mixer state and compare rendered output/peaks with effect enabled and bypassed.

tasks.title: Rune project save, reopen, and engine history
tasks.area: Rune project lifecycle and undo history
tasks.goal: Make the Rune editing journey durable by using established project persistence and engine undo/redo behavior.
acceptance: Create/open/save/reopen projects using the existing product format and preserve supported project content without silent loss.
Dirty state, save errors, overwrite decisions, undo/redo availability, and first-save behavior reflect the engine's established contracts.
Clip, note, mixer, and effect edits remain correct after save/reopen; Rune does not use local snapshot undo as a substitute for engine history.
Recovery and interrupted-operation outcomes are explicit, tested, and do not weaken current data-safety behavior.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.
tasks.terra_human_scenario: Create or open a real project, make clip/note/mixer edits, undo and redo, save, close Rune, reopen, and confirm the song and history controls are truthful. Terra checks the reopened project and resulting render/state.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Round-trip representative existing project fixtures and edited projects; cover dirty close, invalid path, permission/write failure, overwrite, undo/redo availability, and canonical content compatibility.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Use the actual engine file commands and product project format; compare reopened engine state and rendered output to the pre-save expectation.

tasks.title: Rune render and export workflow
tasks.goal: Let users render a saved composition through the existing engine and understand progress and failure outcomes.
acceptance: Choose supported render settings and destination, start a real render, receive completion/progress or asynchronous acknowledgment, and handle cancellation and failure visibly.
Exported output has the requested supported format and duration and is not silently empty or stale.
Render operation does not block the UI command path or misrepresent the engine's asynchronous completion contract.

tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Test supported settings, asynchronous start/completion, cancellation, invalid destination, file format/duration, and non-silent expected audio using stable engine fixtures.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Run a product-engine render and preserve the output file metadata and audio/peak inspection evidence; no UI screenshot is accepted as render proof.

tasks.title: Rune recording and take preservation
tasks.area: Rune recording, monitoring, and take workflow
tasks.goal: Provide a safe basic real-input recording journey that arms, monitors, records, and preserves a take through the engine.
acceptance: Select a supported input, arm a track, communicate monitoring and capture state, record, stop, and identify the resulting take.
Save/reopen preserves the take; interruption, unavailable device, disk/write failure, and disarm/stop behavior do not silently lose or mislabel recorded data.
Real input evidence identifies platform, device/backend, capture state, and resulting audio/take data; Dummy input is not counted as recording proof.
Existing realtime constraints and recording route limits remain enforced.

Terra reviews the applicable cases from plans/rune-review-scenarios.json on the pinned Rune build. Required cases need observed PASS; missing prerequisites, UNSURE or skipped cases remain incomplete. Preserve independent code review and separately measured platform, latency and audio evidence.

tasks.terra_human_scenario: On an available real input, select the device, arm and monitor a track, record a short signal, stop, save/reopen, and verify the take plays back. Terra uses a safe signal source and records capture plus playback evidence.
tasks.deterministic_test_proof: Exercise device unavailable, arm/record/stop state transitions, bounded routes, interruption and write failure, take save/reopen, and playback using deterministic capture fixtures in addition to manual real-device proof.
tasks.real_engine_testability: Requires a real supported capture path and preserved take evidence on each claimed platform. Headless simulated capture is useful regression coverage but not proof of working device input.

tasks.title: Rune plug-in editor and built-in parameter access
tasks.goal: Make hosted plug-ins usable from Rune while preserving native third-party editor windows and access to built-in parameters.
acceptance: Open, focus, raise, and close a supported native plug-in editor beside Rune on supported Linux window systems, Windows, and macOS, documenting gaps by host/platform.
Expose a usable parameter-editing path for built-in plug-ins without a bespoke Rune view and keep displayed values synchronized with engine state.
Plug-in state, automation, project save/reopen, and engine lifecycle remain correct; known unsupported editor cases are explicit.

tasks.title: Rune accessibility, parity inventory, and adoption gate
tasks.goal: Complete the first-session journey's accessibility and platform parity evidence and give the owner a traceable Rune adoption decision packet while Qt remains available.
acceptance: Keyboard navigation, command/menu discoverability, focus and selection feedback, screen-reader roles/names/states, scaling, and contrast support the first-session journey across supported platforms.

Build a traceable inventory from the current advertised feature set, control surface, Qt workflows, and platform support, classifying each as equivalent, owner-accepted deferred, or blocked with evidence.
Run complete musician sessions through Terra's centralized human-use review; all findings follow existing independent review, repair budgets, and Terra priority/promotion rules.

Performance, startup, interaction latency, memory, packaging, audio, recording, plug-in, and accessibility evidence identify platform and test conditions and compare against budgets established from Phase 0/baseline.

Present a reversible adoption recommendation to the owner. This task does not switch the default, remove Qt, delete widget tests, or weaken existing gates; default adoption and any later Qt retirement remain separate explicit owner decisions.
